adds.rationale: NuScale Power completed its SPAC merger and began trading in May 2022 as the first pure-play publicly listed small modular reactor company, giving direct exposure to the profile's near-term fission-SMR wave that was previously uncovered in the watchlist.

news_evidence.summary: NuScale Power completes merger with Spring Valley Acquisition Corp, begins trading on NYSE under ticker SMR; ~$1.9B enterprise value and ~$380M gross proceeds (incl. $235M PIPE) to fund SMR commercialization

adds.rationale: Ukraine-war-driven weapons replenishment is producing concrete order flow for Lockheed's Javelin/Stinger lines, filling the profile's explicit call to own a US defense prime alongside the broad ETF (ITA) already held.

news_evidence.summary: Lockheed Martin CEO James Taiclet says company will nearly double Javelin production to 4,000 units/year amid Ukraine-driven demand; Biden tours Javelin factory
US Army signs deal to backfill Stingers sent to Ukraine, adding to the Lockheed-Raytheon Javelin joint-venture backlog build from prior contract mods ($239M, $309M)

adds.rationale: Russia-sanctions-driven rerouting of oil trade flows is structurally lengthening tanker voyages and lifting spot rates, matching the profile's named tactical tanker/freight exposure for tightening oil-reroute dynamics.

news_evidence.summary: Frontline Q1 2022 earnings call: CEO says 'volatility returned to the tanker market' as Ukraine war and Russia sanctions create new, longer trade lanes into Europe; Q2 guided spot TCE roughly doubled quarter-over-quarter for Suezmax ($32,700 vs $16,900/day) and LR2 ($46,300 vs $19,000/day)
news_evidence.source: Motley Fool (Frontline Q1 2022 earnings call transcript)

news_evidence.summary: EU adopts sixth sanctions package banning seaborne Russian crude oil imports, forcing tankers onto longer alternative routes and tightening global tanker supply

removes.rationale: A credible short-seller report attacking the core technical claims (qubit count, error rates) and revenue recognition, followed by multiple securities-fraud class actions, is a direct thesis-integrity breach on the watchlist's only quantum-computing holding.

news_evidence.summary: Scorpion Capital releases investigative report alleging IonQ misrepresented its qubit count and error rates and derived a significant share of revenue from improper related-party 'round-tripping' transactions
news_evidence.source: The D&O Diary (summarizing Scorpion Capital report)

news_evidence.summary: Securities class action filed in the District of Maryland against IonQ and two officers, covering purchasers from March 30, 2021 through May 2, 2022
news_evidence.source: Rosen Law Firm case filing summary

news_evidence.summary: Investor alert reminding shareholders of the lead-plaintiff deadline in the IonQ securities class action, confirming multiple law firms are pursuing the case

rationale_overall: Net effect: the watchlist gains its first direct nuclear-SMR exposure (SMR) and rounds out the geopolitical/rearmament and tanker-freight legs the profile explicitly names (LMT alongside the existing ITA; FRO for sanctions-driven rerouting), while dropping the sole quantum-computing name (IONQ) on a credible, dated short-seller fraud allegation and subsequent securities litigation rather than mere volatility. AI-core holdings (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA) and the rockets/spacecraft position (RKLB, which posted three successful Q2 launches including the CAPSTONE lunar mission) are kept as-is; NVDA's May 2022 guidance trim was macro/COVID-lockdown noise, not a thesis breach. No robotics, humanoid-robot, healthcare, or eldercare candidate cleared the bar for a dated commercial catalyst this quarter, so demographics and robotics remain unfilled next-wave gaps to revisit.
